fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-24 at roughly 20:10, it was reported that the email and banking application of the complainant were accessed without permission after an OTP was shared during a call, and Rs. 9,900 was moved out. The online submission was made by Lokesh Murugan (9000000325). The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Prakash Palanisamy, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000156. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Account reportedly accessed from an unfamiliar device and funds transferred out.
fields.Keywords: account takeover, unauthorised access, college road, associate, witness, evening, screenshot
